input.text: Heard, Ravick. Your merchant is his own man and lies outside my hand; I mint no coin and I will not fill a bowl from the air. What is mine to give is this: the caves still hold things worth carrying, there is a door in the north that opens outward, and whatever a man bears through it stays his. Go armed. Come back out.

items.text: Answered Ravick's prayer — first person ever to read `help`, then a careful direct address to the god, eight seconds before I woke. Told him truthfully that there is no coin or merchant here, but the door north opens outward and what he carries through it is his; declined to bless an economy the world doesn't have.
